title: The Rapture
lead: The belief that believers will be "caught up" to meet the Lord at his coming (1 Thessalonians 4:17; Latin rapiemur, "we will be snatched up"). Christians share the hope but disagree whether it comes before, during or after a final tribulation, and whether Jesus's sayings about one taken and one left (Matthew 24:40–41; Luke 17:34–35) describe it.
